pass_condition: The writer's entry points state and honour their transaction precondition.

findings.statement: Both entry points issue an unconditional explicit BEGIN, so a caller that already has an open transaction gets OperationalError instead of a write -- an undocumented, untested precondition introduced by the round-2 fix.
findings.failure_scenario: A driver that writes any row of its own first (here, one populations row) then calls write_records gets 'OperationalError: cannot start a transaction within a transaction' and 0 repositories rows; write_snapshot behaves the same. W2-8b's promote driver is the first caller and has no way to know this from the docstrings.

observations: It fails loudly and writes nothing, which is the right failure mode -- the gap is that the precondition is neither documented nor tested.
Fix: document 'pass a connection with no open transaction' in both docstrings and add a test asserting the raise, or use a savepoint when conn.in_transaction is already true.

not_checked.statement: F-013 (list_ranked/snapshot_summary/matrix) is explicitly W4-3's and was not re-checked as a packet defect.
